highlights.title: Claude Fable 5.2 is in the model picker
highlights.line: You can pick Claude Fable 5.2 for an agent: the newest and most capable Fable, and cheaper per token than Fable 5.1.

highlights.title: Images, video and voice on Connections
highlights.line: Connections has a new Images, video and voice group: connect Replicate or ElevenLabs with a key, and Kosmos checks the key with the service.

highlights.title: A suggested answer beside the question
highlights.line: When an agent holds a task for your answer, it can add the answer it suggests, shown beside its question on the task and in Tasks.

highlights.title: See what your agents found on Connections
highlights.line: Settings > Connections lists which actions of a service worked or were refused when your agents used it, so the next agent knows first.

highlights.title: Restarting agents on Windows read as running
highlights.line: On Windows, an agent restarted on this version reads as running, not "Not running", while its Claude restarts or waits on a task.
